Package game.windows

Class EndWindow

java.lang.Object
game.windows.BasicWindow
game.windows.EndWindow
public class EndWindow extends BasicWindow
This class represents the end window of the game, which is displayed when the game is over. It shows the player's score and time and options to play again or quit.
Author:
Maksym Kulynych
